text: Lwazi's knee surgery is booked for June 3rd. He sounded fine about it but his wife says he hasn't been sleeping.
Remind me to ask Krisztina how her mum's hip replacement went. It was supposed to be last Thursday.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Saturday and renew the car insurance by the end of the month.
Mandla is leaving the agency at the end of the month. His last day is 10/30 and there are drinks at the Crown afterwards.

Chat with Oscar after the client call. Their new account director, Teresa, wants everything in writing from now on. He thinks she's going to be hard work. The renewal is due sometime in early December and Krisztina is already panicking about the pricing. We agreed to put together a one-page summary for Teresa by November 8th, and Oscar will take the first pass at it.
Fatima had her gallbladder out on Monday. Home now but still very sore. I should drop round some soup sometime next week.
Julien's partner Ines is expecting! Due early March. They only told a few people.
Note to self: dentist moved to 11/12 at 9:15. Need to ask for the morning off.
Zhang has been made team lead. Officially starts January 6th, once Marcus moves over to the Singapore office.

Alina's dog Biscuit had to have a tumour removed. She was in bits on the phone this morning. Vet says he should be fine but they're waiting on the biopsy results, probably sometime next week. Don't forget to message her on Friday to see if they've heard anything.
Akira is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the team lunch.

Isabel's father is in the Royal Infirmary with pneumonia. She's flying up to Glasgow tonight and won't be back until at least the 20th. Her brother Sam is driving up from Bristol to join her. She asked me to keep an eye on her inbox and push back the Schmidt review, which I've done. Remind me to text her on Sunday to see how her dad is doing.
Need to email Ioana the revised proposal before her board meeting on Tuesday.
James mentioned he collects vintage fountain pens. His birthday is 12/2, so a nice ink set might go down well.
Natasha and her husband are moving to Leeds over the summer. She's already applied for a transfer.
Just got off the phone with Chioma. Her MRI is on May 14, and she's quite anxious about it because of what happened last time. Must text her the night before.
Meera said the Bianchi contract has been put on hold until early next year. Nobody seems to know why.
Ellie's wedding in September has been called off. She and Tom split up a few weeks ago. She seemed okay but quiet.
Elif starts her new job at the hospital on 4/7. She's a bit nervous about the night shifts.
Ifeoma's daughter Demi has her tonsils out on the 9th. Ifeoma is more worried than Demi is, apparently.
Book the MOT, buy a birthday card for Mum, and sort out the gutter before the weather turns.
Andile is presenting to the Fischer board on November 18th. He's rehearsed it to death and is still terrified. I should send him a good luck text that morning.
Eilidh and Isla got engaged on holiday in Portugal! Wedding probably over the summer next year.

Spoke to Julia about the reorg. Her manager is being made redundant and she's worried she's next. There's a consultation meeting sometime next week. She's been with the company eleven years and has a mortgage to think about, so she's understandably rattled. I said I'd look over her CV with her. Need to set aside an evening for that before the meeting, maybe Monday or Tuesday.
Adriana's cat Pepper went missing on Sunday. Still no sign of her.

Reggie had his hernia operation yesterday and is already complaining about the hospital food, so he must be feeling better. He's off work for six weeks and his boss is not happy about it. Remind me to call him at the weekend, and maybe take round the crossword books he likes.
Teresa from procurement prefers phone calls to emails. She also hates being copied in on long threads.
Got my flu jab booked for 10/28. Also need to pick up my prescription before then.
Sam's grandad passed away on Saturday. The funeral is on the 31st. Need to send a card.
Krisztina mentioned her brother Oscar is starting a PhD in Vienna in early October. She's very proud of him.
Chidi's appraisal is on Thursday. He's hoping for the senior role but his manager has been vague.

Met Mr Petrov's daughter, Natasha, at the hospital. Her dad's recovery from the bypass is going slower than expected. They're hoping he can go home by the end of the month. Natasha has been staying at his flat to look after his parrot, Kiki, and travelling in every day. She looked exhausted. I gave her my number in case she needs a lift or anything at all.
Lwazi says the surgery went well. Physio starts on June 10th.
Don't forget to ask Mandla whether he heard back about the Novak job.
I've got the scan on 3/22 and the follow-up a fortnight later. Clear the diary for both.
Oscar is back at work after his shoulder op. Still can't lift anything heavy.

Fatima's son Andile has his driving test on August 2nd. Third attempt, and she says he's a nervous wreck. He failed the last one on a roundabout and has been practising with his uncle every evening since. Fatima is trying not to make a fuss. I should text him good luck the night before.
Zhang and his wife are off to Japan for three weeks in April. Their first proper holiday since the twins were born.
Isabel's dad is out of hospital. She's back at work on Monday but will be working from home for a bit.
Marcus is very into cycling. Rides with a club every Sunday morning and is training for a sportive in late June.

Ines had a scare at her twelve-week scan but everything looks fine now. Next appointment is around the middle of next month. I really ought to send her something small, maybe the baby book she mentioned.
Ring the council about the bins. Again.
Akira's annual review got pushed to sometime in December. He's relieved, honestly.

Ellie said her mum has a hip operation on 11/5 and she'll be looking after her for a couple of weeks. She asked if I could cover her clients while she's away. I said yes. Remind me to brief Julien on the Haddad account before she goes.
Julia didn't get made redundant in the end. Instead she's moving to the analytics team from 1/15.
Alina says Biscuit's biopsy came back clear. Huge relief.
Meera is gluten free, and her husband Reggie is allergic to nuts.
Chioma's MRI was fine, nothing new. She's seeing the consultant again sometime in the spring.
Need to finish the expenses report by Friday and book the train to Manchester for the 7th.

Lunch with Ioana. Her company is being bought out and everyone is anxious. Her boss told them nothing will change, which nobody believes. The deal is supposed to close at the end of the quarter, probably around December 15th. I should check in with her after the announcement, and maybe introduce her to Elif, whose firm went through the same thing last year.
Demi's tonsillectomy went fine. She's living on ice cream.
The team away day on October 24th has been cancelled. Apparently there's a budget freeze.
Eilidh has a hospital appointment on 5/2 about her migraines. She's had them for years and is fed up.
Andile passed his driving test! Must send him a congratulations card.
Spoke to Dr Ito about Mum's results. Nothing to worry about, but she wants to repeat the bloods in early June.
Chidi got the senior role. Starts in it from the first of next month. He's taking everyone out for drinks on the 14th to celebrate.
Remember to cancel the gym membership before it renews on 11/1.

Isla is going in for a minor procedure on her wrist sometime next week. She plays the cello, so she's worried about how long recovery will take. She has a recital booked for March 3rd and her teacher said she might have to pull out. Her girlfriend Eilidh is taking her in and staying with her afterwards. Don't forget to check in with her once it's done.
James's wife, Adriana, has just been signed off work for stress. He said she's been struggling since the summer. I need to ask him how she's doing next time we talk, without making a big thing of it.
Quiet day. Nothing much to report.
